analogy.rationale: Aldose reductase (AKR1B1) is a housekeeping polyol-pathway enzyme with low, non-oncogenic expression in these lines, so its inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional change; ACE inhibitors share the same annotated target set and are similarly expected to be quiet, while antioxidant/anti-inflammatory classes may weakly overlap stress-response signatures.
